title: Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Retinal Fundus Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.26686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the growing number of public datasets, annotated medical images remain scarce. Supervised learning methods achieve strong performance on many benchmarks, however require large amounts of labeled data, which are costly and time-consuming to obtain in the medical domain. To address this limitation, contrastive self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising alternative for learning useful representations from unlabeled data. In this work, we investigate two SSL frameworks, SimSiam and SimCLR, for retinal disease classification from fundus images. We focus on understanding how augmentation strategies and training parameters influence representation learning under resource-constrained settings. Given limited data and computational capacity, we explore the feasibility of training SSL models with small batch sizes incorporated with retinal-specific augmentation techniques. translated_title: 面向视网膜眼底分类的领域特定自监督表示学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26686v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管公开数据集数量不断增加，但带注释的医学图像仍然稀缺。监督学习方法在许多基准测试上表现强劲，但需要大量标记数据，而在医学领域获取这些数据成本高昂且耗时。为解决这一限制，对比自监督学习（SSL）已成为从无标签数据中学习有用表示的一种有前景的替代方案。在这项工作中，我们研究了两种SSL框架，SimSiam和SimCLR，用于眼底图像的视网膜疾病分类。我们专注于理解在资源受限环境下，增强策略和训练参数如何影响表示学习。鉴于有限的数据和计算能力，我们探索了使用小批量大小结合视网膜特定增强技术训练SSL模型的可行性。通过一系列实验，我们评估了表示质量。
tldr: 本文探讨了在资源受限条件下，通过结合视网膜特定增强技术和小批量训练，使用SimSiam和SimCLR自监督学习框架实现有效的眼底图像分类。
en_tdlr: This paper explores the feasibility of using SimSiam and SimCLR self-supervised learning frameworks with retinal-specific augmentations and small batch sizes for effective fundus image classification under resource-constrained settings.
